optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Review and potentially restart AI processes to ensure they are actively learning and generating opportunities.
Evaluate the trading strategies to ensure they are correctly configured and capable of initiating trades.

recommendations.rationale: Sustained high CPU load can lead to system instability, affecting the platform's performance and user experience.

recommendations.action: Verify the operational status of the AI subsystem and ensure it is configured to perform learning cycles and generate trading opportunities.
